opportunities.title: Triple-A's Wallet Is Still Bleeding: How a 'Confirmed Breach' Became a Live Drain to $11.8M
opportunities.why_now: Reports show new deposits are still being swept into the attacker's wallet even after Triple-A publicly confirmed the breach, meaning the 'incident' is still active.
opportunities.angle: Timeline/forensics breakdown — show the gap between disclosure and containment, with a checklist for what a real incident response should look like vs. what Triple-A is doing

opportunities.title: SparkKitty Is in Your Photo Roll Right Now: The Malware That Hunts Seed Phrase Screenshots
opportunities.why_now: A new mobile malware strain is confirmed scanning photo libraries specifically for crypto seed phrases, hitting the most common self-custody mistake — screenshotting your recovery phrase.
opportunities.angle: Practical opsec explainer: how SparkKitty works, why 'just a screenshot' is the #1 wallet-drainer vector, and a 3-step fix (delete screenshots, use metal backup, audit app permissions)

opportunities.title: Bitkub Didn't Just Get Hacked for $47M — It Allegedly Hid It From Regulators
opportunities.why_now: Thailand's SEC filed a criminal complaint alleging Bitkub concealed a $47M hack, turning a security incident into a disclosure-fraud case with legal teeth.
opportunities.angle: 'This is how it always ends' case study: exchange hack → cover-up → regulator finds out anyway → criminal complaint. Use as a template to predict which current 'unconfirmed' incidents get this treatment next

opportunities.title: Exploit, Bankruptcy, Wind-Down: SummerFi, Storj, Poolin and BitMart Died in the Same Week
opportunities.why_now: Four unrelated crypto entities — a DeFi protocol citing an exploit, a storage token filer, a mining pool, and an exchange — all shut down within days of each other, exposing how thin the margin for a single security failure has become.
opportunities.angle: Roundup/pattern piece: 'the shutdown wave' — map each collapse back to a security or trust failure, argue this is the new normal cost of running unaudited infra in a bear-liquidity market

opportunities.title: Quantum Computing Won't Wait for Your Roadmap — Why Crypto Is the Canary, Not the Exception
opportunities.why_now: Security experts are flagging crypto as the first real-world casualty of quantum decryption risk, right as Hoskinson warns Bitcoin could lose dominance if it fails a 'quantum test.'
opportunities.angle: Explainer with a hard edge: what a quantum break actually does to ECDSA-signed wallets, why 'we'll upgrade later' is the same complacency that preceded every hack on this list, timeline for when this stops being theoretical
